text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/` and left the tests alone. I haven't run `python3 -m unittest` because I don't have a shell here. I checked each fix against what its test expects, so please run the suite to confirm everything passes.

- **`fees.py`**: the late fee added the days to the daily rate instead of multiplying them. It's now `days_late * DAILY_FEE`.
- **`members.py`**: the borrowing limit was 3, but the comment above it and the tests both say 5. Changed to `MAX_BORROWED = 5`.
- **`inventory.py`**: `recent(n)` returned one event too many. It now returns exactly the last `n`, and an empty list when `n <= 0` (no test covers that case).
- **`factory.py`**: the sample catalog was missing `Emma`. I added it as `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`; the tests only check the title, so I picked the author, year and copy count.
- **`books.py`**: `parse_book` kept the year as text, so the year check and `age()` failed. It now converts the year with `int(year)`.
- **`search.py`**: it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist (`catalog.nonexistent`). It now imports it from `catalog.text`.
